pages.title: The Next Wave
pages.text: Coral blocks extend the young-fish nursery and sandwiches supply the next dive.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Tuna develops from an egg; buckets accept only eligible young stages. Adult Tuna and Sunfish do not fit a bucket. Dodos are not an alternative breeding target.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use Casting Nets, buckets or a Nautilus Shell according to the native animal entry and growth stage. Large adults may reject buckets while certain smaller creatures fit.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use native Dodo documentation before proposing a breeding task. The installed text explicitly calls Dodos incapable of breeding and swimming.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Breed Tuna or Sunfish and bucket only eligible young forms. Tuna eggs develop into babies; mature Tuna/Sunfish no longer fit a bucket.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Pay a Seal live fish for a ride, observe paired Booby mating, and protect Dodos from water. Native descriptions distinguish transport, lifelong pairing, and Dodo inability to breed or swim.
